title: Performance of 4.54 MLD STP using MBR technology, Delhi
markdown:
| Parameter | Unit | Influent | Effluent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pH | - | 7.0 - 7.6 | 6.8 – 7.8 |
| Temperature | °C | 18 - 38 | - |
| TSS | mg/l | 400 | <1.0 |
| BOD5 | mg/l | 250 | <2 |
| Total COD | mg/l | 750 | - |
| Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen | mg/l | 40 | <1.0 |
| Total NH₄⁺-N | mg/l | 25 | <0.5 |
| Total Alkalinity | mg/l | 305 | - |
| Total Coliform | MPN/100 ml | - | 2 |
notes: Printed below the table: 'Source:  Pamphlet issued by DJB'.
Printed as 'BOD5' with the 5 on the baseline (no subscript glyph is printed); retained as printed.
The pH effluent range is printed with a longer dash (6.8 – 7.8) than the influent range (7.0 - 7.6); retained.
Rows with no effluent value print '-' rather than a number; retained.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 360-480 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All nine rows read from a 300 dpi crop; inequality signs (<1.0, <2, <0.5) and 'MPN/100 ml' checked individually.
